page.overview:
Who is Cynthia?

Cynthia (シロナ Shirona) is an archaeologist and the Pokémon Champion of the Sinnoh region, where Professor Carolina, her grandmother, runs the Pokémon Research Lab in Celestic Town.

Cynthia is a tall and slender young woman with gray eyes and wavy knee-length creamy blonde fringe hair that covers her left eye with bangs. She wears black straight leg trousers, a long black coat with a V-shaped neck and black fur rimming its cuffs and hem, and a teardrop shaped pearl on the center of the coat. Under the coat, she dons a black top. Cynthia's outfit is finished with black kitten heel pumps possessing each a yellow stripe. For accessories, she wears a black fur ruff around her neck with two pairs of hair clips on each side of her hair, both teardrop shaped and possessing a yellow stripe.

Cynthia is a passionate and humble Trainer who takes Pokémon battles very seriously. She is also seen to be a kind person who so deeply cares for both Pokémon and her friends that she helps out Trainers who look up to her and gives them tips on their journeys.

She tends to enjoy relaxation and travel, visiting the villas owned by Unova Elite Four member Caitlin and the player character found in that region, and in Sinnoh's Battle Zone respectively. In Pokémon Platinum Version, she expresses that part of the reason for this is that she is usually a messy person, and has research papers thrown around the house. Cynthia, as suggested by her theme song, also enjoys the piano, claiming that she enjoys the sound, listening to it with both her body and spirit.
